stack: Isolated docker compose project didhack-t02; simulation ROS_DOMAIN_ID=7, GZ_PARTITION=did; main compose stack not restarted.

implementation.scan_to_world: LaserScan hits are transformed through the backend world pose, downsampled by four, and filtered by finite range <= 4 m.
implementation.dynamic_map: Inflated overlay uses TTL 1.0 s, requires 2 scan confirmations within 0.35 s, and groups hits into configurable 0.10 m coarse cells to reduce lidar endpoint jitter.
implementation.immediate_guard: Current scan hits still feed the braking corridor immediately; corridor includes robot clearance, measured scan age, reaction time, speed, and configured deceleration.
implementation.revision_fix: Overlay revision changes only when inflated blocked cells change, not when per-cell TTL is refreshed.

verification.backend_tests: pytest -q backend/tests: 195 passed, 2 skipped after T09 overlay aggregation.

stale_scan_probe.setup: Isolated Gazebo probe; lidar rate reduced 5 Hz→0.1 Hz during motion.
stale_scan_probe.recovery: Lidar rate restored to 5 Hz; /scan messages resumed.

obstacle_spawn.placement: observer inserted the model 0.42 m ahead of the first nonzero linear command, converting /odom to world coordinates with (-2.0, -0.5).

historical_failed_obstacle_probe.interpretation: The robot stopped before the detected obstacle and moved around its north side without a public collision. It later could not validate a route home while the obstacle remained; autonomous mission completion with an obstacle is not yet accepted.
historical_failed_obstacle_probe.note: Superseded by later seed23/gen1 completed obstacle mission at safe 0.65 m placement and direct physical pose/contact probes.

historical_return_route_diagnosis.method: Loaded the same static map into NavigationService and added a synthetic 0.32 m box footprint at the live world location, then requested a route from the terminal robot pose to base.
historical_return_route_diagnosis.interpretation: The box footprint alone does not make home unreachable in the static map. The live no_route_home likely depends on the cumulative scan overlay or live coordinate/occupancy samples; capture the full dynamic cell set next before changing route policy.
historical_return_route_diagnosis.note: Old near-base placement was under the robot footprint after map-cell quantization; later placement at 0.65 m away remained traversable and TTL probes confirmed return routes.
